research_contract.target: Within the fixed Multi-SWE development panel, find whether a cutoff-safe response forecast followed by budget-ten response assembly can lower repository-first future pass-rate MAE.
research_contract.working_definition_of_current_task_pool: The outcome-open Multi-SWE source projection bound by examples/multi_swe_research/contract.json: 1,632 Tasks and 36 complete public Agent configurations. It is research evidence, not a certified runnable Task Pool.
research_contract.primary_outcome: For every target Agent configuration and rolling Origin, absolute selected-history pass rate minus future-cohort pass rate; average configurations and Origins within repository, then repositories equally.
research_contract.primary_frame: Standard non-overlapping H5 frame: 221 Origins in 13 repositories.
research_contract.sensitivity_frame: Standard non-overlapping H10 frame: 107 Origins in 11 repositories. H10 is not an independent replication.
research_contract.numeric_progress: On its own information-contract lane and the same standard frame, H5 candidate-minus-full is below ALG-007's -0.0022539773355357935 and H10 candidate-minus-full is at most zero.
research_contract.development_nomination: H5 difference at most -0.010, at least 10/13 repositories favorable, every leave-one-repository-out aggregate favorable, deep aggregate favorable, repository bootstrap upper bound below zero, and random midrank at least 0.90; H10 difference below zero, at least 8/11 repositories favorable, and deep aggregate favorable.
required_evidence: direct standard-frame H5 and H10 pass-rate MAE for every frozen candidate
full-history, ordinary-recency, exact-full-target response assembly, and unchanged ALG-007 controls
repository-first wide and deep aggregates, favorable repositories, leave-one-repository-out directions, Agent/model/harness directions, and repository bootstrap
continuous forecast error and forecast-to-selection materialization error as non-gating diagnostics
two byte-identical executions, membership digests, result digest, and independent adversarial audit
insufficient_outcomes: forecast MAE, Brier loss, AUC, embedding loss, response-vector loss, or materialization loss presented as final pass-rate MAE
a pooled Task, Origin, or Agent average that lets long repositories dominate
a favorable random percentile without beating full history
a cached-target result used to support an unseen-target claim
target-Agent outcomes entering an unseen-target membership pipeline
future Task attributes or outcomes entering any membership pipeline
hindsight-oracle memberships or a post-score algorithm or parameter rescue
a development-panel result claimed as independent confirmation or a Runner default

fixed_facts.ordering: projected GitHub pull-request createdAt, then instance_id
fixed_facts.time_status: counterfactual source-time projection, not native Task arrival time

hypotheses: Full history is biased after a response regime change; cutoff-safe adaptive forecasts may reduce that temporal bias.
A continuous future response forecast and a budget-ten materializer are separate error sources and should be measured separately.
Other Agent response vectors may transfer enough information to assemble a useful benchmark for an unseen target Agent.
Cached target-Agent Results define a stronger but narrower information contract and may support a different adaptive Selector.

cached_target.claim: Selection for an Agent with imported or cached Results on all eligible history Tasks.
allowed_inputs: target-repository historical Task identities and projected times
the target Agent's outcomes on eligible history Tasks
earlier complete rolling-Origin outcomes whose future block ended before the current cutoff
forbidden_inputs: future Task content, patches, or retrospective attributes

unseen_target.claim: Selection for a new Agent before lazy execution.
allowed_inputs: target-repository historical Task identities and projected times
the other 35 public reference Agents' outcomes on eligible history Tasks
earlier complete rolling-Origin outcomes whose future block ended before the current cutoff
forbidden_inputs: the target Agent's outcome column anywhere in forecast or materialization
future Task content, patches, or retrospective attributes

portfolio.mechanism: For each target Agent and repository, combine four cutoff-safe scalar pass-rate experts with AdaNormalHedge: full history, latest H, latest 2H, and clipped one-block linear drift. Update expert regrets only after an earlier non-overlapping future block is complete. Select ten history Tasks whose cached target-Agent success count is closest to the continuous forecast; ties prefer newer projected time then instance_id.
portfolio.cold_start: Uniform expert mixture with zero regret and zero absolute regret.

parameters.tie_rule: minimum absolute scalar error, then newest projected time and instance_id

portfolio.mechanism: For each target Agent held out completely, run the same four AdaNormalHedge experts independently on each of the other 35 response coordinates. Assemble exactly ten target-repository history Tasks to minimize L1 distance between their 35-dimensional response mean and the forecast.
portfolio.cold_start: Uniform expert mixture with zero regret and zero absolute regret.

portfolio.mechanism: For each target Agent held out completely, use a shared-run-length Bayesian online change-point posterior over the other 35 Beta-Bernoulli response streams. The base prior has mass ten and the Jeffreys-smoothed local full-history mean. Forecast H steps while allowing reversion to the local anchor, then use the same exact L1 materializer.
ablations: posterior forecast with full-history target materialization

portfolio.mechanism: Fit one bounded no-intercept LAD drift model from non-target repositories whose training future blocks ended before cutoff. Predict response-coordinate change from recent-5 minus full, recent-10 minus full, and recent-5 minus previous-5, then use the same exact L1 materializer.

parameters.weighting: repositories equal, Origins within repository equal, reference Agents within Origin equal
parameters.fallback: zero coefficients when no eligible training Origins

portfolio.execution_priority: Only after ALG-015C, ALG-015U, and ALG-016U unless wall-clock projection leaves at least ninety minutes.

shared_materializer.objective: Minimize mean absolute response-coordinate error between an unweighted budget-ten subset and the continuous forecast.
shared_materializer.compression: Group history Tasks by identical visible binary response pattern and optimize bounded integer pattern counts.
shared_materializer.determinism: Sort response patterns lexicographically, use deterministic HiGHS execution, and choose newest projected Tasks within a selected pattern. Two complete executions must produce identical bytes.
shared_materializer.fallback: No silent fallback. If exact execution projects beyond the sprint boundary, freeze and bind a deterministic greedy-plus-one-swap amendment before reading candidate scores.

controls: exact response assembly targeting full-history response rates

rolling_origin.cross_repository_eligibility: A training Origin's complete future block must end no later than the target Origin cutoff.
rolling_origin.aggregation: Target configurations and Origins within repository, then repositories equally.

random_protocol.coupling: One equal-budget subset per Origin and draw, shared across all 36 target configurations.

failure_model: opened-panel winner's curse from comparing four frozen candidates
target-Agent leakage in an unseen-target membership
repository pooling that overweights long histories
forecast improvement lost during budget-ten quantization
response-vector fit that does not transfer to the held-out Agent
shared change-point overconfidence caused by correlated Agent responses
sparse positives and few completed Origins causing unstable adaptation
H5-only gain that reverses at H10
projected PR time standing in for native Task and Result availability

source_policy.literature: Primary papers may motivate mechanisms and failure models; no source is used to search for an exact Barcarolle solution.
source_policy.opened_outcomes: May be read only after this finite portfolio and metric contract are frozen.
source_policy.hindsight: Existing hindsight aggregate may establish capacity; its memberships are forbidden as algorithm input.

literature.source: Luo and Schapire, Achieving All with No Parameters: AdaNormalHedge, COLT 2015
Adams and MacKay, Bayesian Online Changepoint Detection, 2007
Deville and Tille, Efficient Balanced Sampling: The Cube Method, Biometrika 2004

resource_boundary.allowed_compute: local CPU using already-open public outcomes and ignored bound artifacts

claim_boundary: Outcome-open, time-projected Multi-SWE development evidence only. Cached-target and unseen-target lanes are separate. No result can establish prospective validity, certify a Task Pool, authorize sealed-holdout access, or create a production Selector default.
